data.body: F21 completion evidence. The first implementation still left an implicit DIG claim in docs/config.md and explicit DIG defaults in two connected external tests. The recorded file impact now includes those paths. Two readiness checks failed before the correction because each probe accepted complete Jira credentials without JIRA_PROJECT. The implementation now keeps an unset project empty, requires JIRA_PROJECT in both readiness gates, and reads JIRA_PROJECT without a default in both client builders. Both checks passed after the correction. Removing the second project check made the withheld oracle fail, and restoration returned all eight focused preflight tests to green. Ruff, format checking, the documentation index check, whitespace validation, the commit hook lint gate, and type checking passed. Commit 13ebc0df6ec227c0f7d73804e3433dba48c2e925 retains Change-Id I57fd814ce6b651813e172c249e5c9539329ae224 and the canonical ticket trailer. It has not been pushed.
